title: Shallow equality and memoised selectors
summary: Implement the comparison React.memo uses and a selector that only recomputes when inputs change.
prompt: Write `shallowEqual(a, b)`: true if `Object.is(a, b)`, otherwise both must be non-null objects with the same own enumerable keys and `Object.is`-equal values for each key. Then write `createSelector(inputs, combine)`: `inputs` is an array of functions of the state; the returned selector calls each input and only calls `combine(...results)` when some input result changed (by `Object.is`) since the last call, otherwise it returns the cached result. Expose `recomputations()` on the selector. There is no React Native runtime here, so this is modelled as plain TypeScript.
hints: Compare key counts first, then check each key with `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`.
